newsitem.title: THAILAND: Trade in International Finance halted.
newsitem.headline: Trade in International Finance halted.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) said it had halted trading in International Trust and Finance Plc shares from the afternoon session on Wednesday.
The SET said in a statement it was awaiting material information from the company.
The company's shares were trading unchanged at 4.6 baht each earlier on Wednesday.
ITF said in mid-March that it would issue 130.28 million new shares to raise registered capital to 2.52 billion baht from 1.22 billion baht.
The new shares at 10 baht par would be offered to locals, foreigners or institutional legal entities registered in Thailand or foreign countries, it had said.
ITF is one of 10 liquidity-hit finance companies that was ordered by the Bank of Thailand in early March to raise its capital.
IFT said the proceeds would be used to expand business and restore investor and public confidence in it.
